errors.text: The critical threshold is not identified as approximately 673 K. Instead, a broad estimated interval of 400–800 °C is given, conflating the onset of active segregation near 673 K with the later Au/Cu shell melting and evaporation observed at 973 K.

Falsification criterion (3) is logically inverted: failure without surface-energy gradients and success when gradients are included would support, not falsify, the proposed surface-energy-driven mechanism.
